title: Najir Ahmad v. Managing Director, Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited
coram: Arindam Sinha, J.; Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Status quo on recovery till next date; listed.
headnote: Interim order. Writ challenging a post-disconnection demand of Rs. 1,08,786 after the consumer forum declined jurisdiction. Licensee invoked clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Status quo on recovery; counter directed; merits not decided.
facts: The petitioner challenged a notice dated 8 October 2022 issued by Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited demanding Rs. 1,08,786. He had approached the consumer forum, which held it had no jurisdiction. He contended that Rs. 3,000 was paid on 28 October 2017 when a permanent disconnection was effected, so no further claim could arise. The licensee submitted that a dispute on bills is to be raised under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: interim status quo on recovery of disputed demand
holding_units.holding: The Court did not decide the validity of the 8 October 2022 demand or whether clause 6.5 of the Supply Code is the exclusive remedy. It directed the supply company to file a counter-affidavit within three weeks, listed the writ, and ordered status quo on recovery till the next date of hearing.

not_decided.point: Validity of the demand notice dated 8 October 2022 for Rs. 1,08,786 after alleged permanent disconnection
Whether a bill dispute must be raised under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Invoked by the licensee; not decided
